notes: Projection = full house-to-front dimension with NO overhang. House stringer, rafters, and front beam/gutter all fit within projection.
Default box-perimeter internal rafters use 100x50 unless overridden.
Default aluminium stock length = 6.0m for cut optimisation.
Acrylic roofing is held by aluminium joiners fixed to rafters; no roofing screws/washers.
Added roof_type gable + hip, mixed roof options (acrylic+timber), and ridge length rules for hip. v1 assumptions; calibrate later.

hip_roof.ridge_length_m_formula: max(0, length_m - projection_m)  # assumes 45° hips and ridge runs along length
hip_roof.hip_run_m_formula: (projection_m / 2) * sqrt(2)  # plan run for each hip rafter to ridge end

effective_span_m_by_roof_type.hip: projection_m / 2  # hip common rafters treated as half-span like gable

sheet_2x3.source_note: Cost currently uses Plexi sheet 3050x2030 pricebook item as the closest match until 2x3 supplier price is added.

joiner_system.joiner_count: rafter_count  # one joiner line per rafter

rubbers.notes: Assumes rubbers on both sides of each joiner for both top and bottom pieces. Tune once confirmed.

fasteners.notes: No screws/washers through acrylic. Joiner-to-rafter fixings are counted as a placeholder in hardware_placeholders.

timber.notes: Keep timber roof costing as manual allowance for now.

ridge_skylight.description: Timber roof with one or more 620mm acrylic strips as a skylight running along the ridge (Johanna Smith example).
ridge_skylight.joiner_edge_metres_formula: strip_count * 2 * strip_length_m  # edges only; not full-roof joiner grid

area_override.description: User provides acrylic_area_m2 directly (e.g., custom skylight).

timber_remainder.note: Timber costing remains manual in v1 unless timber pricebook is added.

details: gable: ridge along length; rafters counted both sides (2x rafter_count); ridge_length_m = length_m
hip: ridge_length_m = max(0, length_m - projection_m) (assumes 45° hips); add 4 hip rafters; jack trimming handled via labour multiplier for now
